page-scope.statement: On the Advanced Settings page in the Zscaler Admin Console, an admin can configure settings for a variety of Zscaler service features. The page's sections include Admin Ranking, Advanced Web App Control Options, Kerberos Authentication Exemptions, Digest Authentication Exemptions, Policy for Unauthenticated Traffic, HTTP Tunnel Control, Domain Fronting, Office 365 One Click Configuration, Admin Portal Session Timeout, Internal IP Logging, Windows App Traffic Authentication, Partial Configuration Handling Mechanism (SWG & Firewall), Traffic Forwarded to ZPA to ZIA, Settings for DNS Optimization for IPv6, Firewall Settings for Z-Tunnel 1.0 and PAC (Road Warriors), Enable EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) Option and Real Time Risk Score Updates.

quotes: On the Advanced Settings page in the Zscaler Admin Console, you can configure settings for a variety of Zscaler service features.
Traffic Forwarded to ZPA to ZIA
Settings for DNS Optimization for IPv6
Firewall Settings for Z-Tunnel 1.0 and PAC (Road Warriors)

admin-ranking.statement: Enable Admin Ranking is for an organization that wants to rank administrators and use the ranks when managing policies.

quotes: Enable Admin Ranking: Enable this feature if you want to rank administrators and use the ranks when you manage policies.

session-timeouts.statement: The UI Session Timeout Duration sets how long admins can be inactive in the Zscaler Admin Console before they must log in again, and the API Session Timeout Duration sets how long an API-initiated Admin Console session can be inactive before it must be reauthenticated. All active sessions are forced to reauthenticate after a continuous login period of 720 minutes (12 hours) that is not configurable.

quotes: UI Session Timeout Duration (In Minutes): Specify how long admins can be inactive in the Zscaler Admin Console before they must log in again.
API Session Timeout Duration (In Minutes): Specify how long an API-initiated Zscaler Admin Console session can be inactive before it must be reauthenticated.
All active sessions are forced to reauthenticate after a continuous login period of 720 minutes (12 hours) that is not configurable.

real-time-risk.statement: Real Time Risk Score Updates, when enabled, allows Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS to track activities that might increase user risk in real time.

quotes: Enable this option to allow Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS to track activities that might increase user risk in real time.
